hooks.name: aidlc-lean-guard
hooks.description: AI-DLC Lean: before a file write or command, checks the approvals code needs (IDEATION when Ideation is used, requirements and application design; in regulated mode also the unit's code-generation plan), protected tests, contract ownership, the files only the tool writes, dangerous commands and the verify-before-commit rule. Read tools are not checked. A shell line that only reads the kit's records with cat, head, tail, grep, jq, ls and the like passes; other shell commands that touch the kit's records (sed, awk, find, python, any write) are blocked: read those with a file-read tool.
